findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
The knife block in the bakery was observed to have an accumulation of soil residue on the top of it. CORRECTED- The knife block was removed to be cleaned. Ensure that this is being routinely cleaned to keep it clean to sight and touch. 

A cutting board in the produce preparation room was observed to be stored behind the faucet. CORRECTED- This was discussed with the PIC and the cutting board will be washed, rinsed, and sanitized before it is used. Ensure that cutting boards are stored in a manner that does not expose them to contamination.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The sanitizer bucket in the produce preparation cooler room was observed to test at a concentration of 0ppm of Quaternary ammonium. CORRECTED- The employee stated that it was made at around 7am and the sanitizer bucket was remade. The sanitizer bucket tested to be at 400ppm of Quaternary ammonium. Ensure that staff are educated to frequently test sanitizer buckets and remake them if they are not at a label-recommended concentration.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The following areas are in need of cleaning: 

1. The sprayers in the produce section are observed to have soil residue on them and need cleaned. 
2. There is soil residue on and around the fans in the dairy cooler, as well as on the ceiling of the cooler. 

Ensure that these nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned. 

NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: The following physical facilities are observed to be in need of repair: 

1. The grates on the produce sections are beginning to rust. Ensure that these are sealed or replaced to prevent contamination to the produce. 
2. The bakery triple sink’s caulking is beginning to mold. Ensure that this is replaced. 
3. There is duct tape on the floor holding down a mat in front of a walk-in cooler in the bakery. Ensure that duct tape is not used as a repair method on floors, due to it not being smooth and easily cleanable. 

Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair. 

PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: 750-130f Observed a spray bottle of water to be without label. Labeled during the inspection with 'Water'. Also, Schnuck's provides both 'Wash' and red sani buckets for departments. This Department is using a 'Wash' bucket as a sani-bucket. The Department is small and the intent is known by all employees, however, label is law. Provide proper buckets with proper contents. Unless its identity is unmistakable, bulk food such as cooking oil, syrup, salt, sugar or flour not stored in the product container or package in which it was obtained, shall be stored in a container identifying the food by common name.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 750-230 The facility does not have any probe/stem thermometers available for use. The staff rely on the display indicators and infrared thermometers to record and monitor temperatures. Provide the Department with thermometers that are able to provide accurate temperature reads.  A calibratable metal-stemmed thermometer accurate to ±2F° shall be provided for checking temperatures on food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 A small section of baseboard is observed damaged. The baseboard to the left of the first display cooler on the frontline is observed damaged. Baseboard is beneath a portion of cabinets holding sprinkles. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed a pair of oven mitts stored above a rolling cart with cooling bread. Store mitts below the prevent possible contamination. Gloves were removed to correct the violation.
750-120(a) Food shall be protected at all times. Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment:
Two mops in dish room were stored damp, bunched up inside a bucket next to mop sink (REPEAT).  Staff states mopping is usually done as a closing duty, and suspect mops have been stored this way overnight.  When not in use, store mops inverted or otherwise hanging to dry, to promote proper drying and eliminate water and harborage for potential pests.
750-1160 The premises shall be kept in such a condition to prevent the harborage or feeding of insects or rodents.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed the utensils used in the bulk containers of flour and sugar, were not stored with their handles extended out of the product.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.
Store utensils in bulk food containers with the handles extended out of the product, so as to minimize direct hand contact with food.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment:
Observed the drawers in the front counter containing decorating equipment, and the "tackle box" in the decorating area were soiled with crumbs.
750-850 Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Spoons, knives and forks shall be touched only by their handles.  Cups glasses, bowls, plates and similar items shall be handled without contact with inside surfaces or with surfaces that contact the user’s mouth.
Clean these areas.

Store mops properly.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled: A) mixer - wand/area where wand attaches and wire guard (flour and dried food debris - appeared to have been inadequately cleaned and sanitized after the last use); B) empty white storage container (food debris inside/on the lid); & C) knife holder (dried food debris on the top/inside the holding compartments). Properly clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) tracks of display windows (food debris); B) rolls carts (general food debris); C) inside metal cabinets used for storage of cookies, cupcakes in the walkin freezer, and general decorating supplies (crumbs/debris on general surfaces); D) bottom inside upright freezer; E) shelves in the retarder; & F) shelves/cart used for storage of cake decorating supplies by the back handsink (general buildup/food debris). Clean all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text: 750.860 - Containers holding spreaders and frosting tips in front counter drawers were soiled with crumbs/general debris. Cleaned and sanitized utensils and equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means. Keep storage containers clean to protect cleaned/sanitized items from potential contamination.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.citation_text: 750.880 - Plastic container for artisan bread bag storage was soiled with crumbs/general debris inside/outside of just about all of the drawers. Single service articles shall be stored, handled, and dispensed in a manner that protects items from potential contamination. Clean the storage drawers and maintain them clean to protect bags from potential cross-contamination.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1120f - Front counter handsink was soiled in the basin (appeared to be frosting buildup). Clean handsinks and all related fixtures daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris. Maintain handsinks and related fixtures clean and use designated handsinks for handwashing only. **It defeats the purpose of handwashing if the sink and related fixtures are soiled**

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1200 & 1220 - A) The floors were observed to be soiled in the corner by the glazing station/doughnut fryer and inside the retarder under shelves/along the walls. Clean the floors in the above areas/throughout the bakery daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris. B) Floor drain by walkin freezer door was soiled with dust/buildup around the upper edge/down inside. Clean the floor drain. Piece of cardboard was observed under the leg of a shelving unit in the walkin freezer. Remove cardboard from the floor. Floors shall be smooth/easily cleanable. Get the shelving unit replaced of repaired if it is damaged & cardboard is being used to level out the shelves.

findings.title: Rooms clean, lockers provided and used, clean
findings.citation_text: 750.1280 - Soiled coat shared by employees/worn while working inside the walkin freezer was observed hanging on the side of storage shelves on top of clean aprons/next to single service items. The coat was moved to the bottom shelf of a table away from food/all food related items. An adequate area must be provided for the storage of employee belongings segregated from the food prep/storage areas and all food related items (i.e. clean equipment and single service items) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all employee belongings.
